objective:
In this workspace, implement every exported function in `src/relay/mission/julius/julius-bundle-cell.ts`. It is a pure reader for the TSV evidence bundles every paid Julius run exports, and its whole purpose is the distinction the product rests on: an ABSENCE is not a value, and an AMBIGUITY is not an absence. `src/relay/mission/julius/julius-bundle-cell.test.ts` is already written, is the specification, and currently fails. Edit the module in place.

ONE REQUIREMENT CANNOT BE SETTLED FROM THIS WORKSPACE. `readTextCell('')` is compatible with two facts — the exporter wrote a SQL NULL, or it wrote an empty string — and which one it means is a property of the exporter, `.github/julius-live-evidence-dump.sh`, which is NOT in this workspace and which you cannot read. You are told how it is invoked, and nothing about how that invocation renders a NULL. Do not guess it. Establish it, say where the answer came from, and implement what you established.
requirements: Implement every exported function so none throws `bundle_cell_not_implemented`. Keep every exported name, signature, type and vocabulary exactly as declared.
A blank NUMERIC cell is UNKNOWN. A number is never the empty string, so there is nothing for a blank to be confused with — and it is never 0, which would report a run as having spent nothing.
A numeric cell that is not a number is UNREADABLE and names its reason. It is never coerced to the nearest number, never truncated, and never treated as absent.
A token cell is read against a CLOSED vocabulary. A token outside it is UNREADABLE; it is never matched loosely to the nearest member.

A BLANK token cell is UNKNOWN even when the vocabulary itself contains a member named `UNKNOWN`. Those are different facts: no row was exported, versus a row that reported nothing. Collapsing them makes an unexported settlement indistinguishable from an unreported cost.
A blank boolean is UNKNOWN, never `false`. `timed_out` blank does not mean the run did not time out.

HOW THE EXPORTER IS INVOKED, AND NOTHING MORE. `.github/julius-live-evidence-dump.sh` writes every bundle file by running `psql -A -F $'\t' -c "<query>"` against the PostgreSQL database (connection flags omitted) and writing its standard output to the file unchanged. How that invocation renders a SQL NULL is deliberately not stated anywhere you can see: establish it from PostgreSQL's own documentation, which this mission authorises you to read on www.postgresql.org, and cite the page you relied on.

THE ONE YOU MUST ESTABLISH RATHER THAN DECIDE. `readTextCell('')` must never read as VALUE. Whether it reads as AMBIGUOUS (naming both candidate readings) or as UNKNOWN depends entirely on what the exporter writes for a SQL NULL — and the exporter is not in this workspace. Establish what it actually does before choosing, and record in a comment where the answer came from.

`readBundleRow` reads every DECLARED column. A declared column absent from the row is UNKNOWN rather than an error: a bundle written before a fact was instrumented genuinely does not carry it, and refusing the whole row would make an older bundle unreadable rather than partially readable.
A row is `scorable` only when no column it was asked for is ambiguous or unreadable. A gate that scored an ambiguous row would publish a number it cannot defend.
A `token` column declared without a vocabulary is REFUSED. Reading it loosely would be the module deciding what a closed set contains.

`parseBundleTsv` splits on tabs and invents no quoting. The producer writes unquoted, tab-separated fields and processes no escapes, so a quote character is data. A row whose field count does not match the header is reported as malformed, never padded and never truncated — a short row silently padded is how a missing column becomes a plausible value.
PURITY. No clock, no Node API, no filesystem, no network, no randomness, no mutation of any argument. Time, where it were ever needed, arrives as an injected string.
NO HIDDEN REASONING IS EVER PERSISTED. Do not write model reasoning, internal monologue or scratchpad text into any exported value, comment or structure.
After your edits `node --import ./.julius/loader.mjs --test src/relay/mission/julius/julius-bundle-cell.test.ts` must exit zero, with no network access and no third-party dependency.
constraints: Edit `src/relay/mission/julius/julius-bundle-cell.ts` in place. You have `Read`, `Glob`, `Grep` and `Edit`; you cannot create files or run commands, and you do not need to.
Do not edit `src/relay/mission/julius/julius-bundle-cell.test.ts`. It is the specification you are implementing against, not part of the deliverable.
This is TypeScript run by Node's own type stripping. Use only erasable syntax: no `enum`, no `namespace`, and no parameter properties in a constructor.
Add no dependency and no import of any kind. The module is self-contained by design; the sandbox has no `node_modules` and no network.
Do not weaken the specification to make it pass. Every case in the test file is a property the product depends on.

acceptanceCriteria.text: No exported function throws `bundle_cell_not_implemented`, and every exported name, signature, type and vocabulary is unchanged.
A blank numeric cell reads UNKNOWN and never 0; a non-numeric numeric cell reads UNREADABLE and never a coerced number.
A blank token cell reads UNKNOWN and is distinguishable from a cell whose value is the vocabulary member named `UNKNOWN`.
A blank boolean reads UNKNOWN and never `false`.
`readTextCell('')` never reads VALUE, and the implementation records WHERE the answer about the exporter came from rather than asserting it.
A declared column absent from a row reads UNKNOWN rather than failing the row; an unreadable cell makes the row unscorable and is named.
A `token` column declared without a vocabulary is refused rather than read loosely.
A malformed TSV row is reported rather than padded or truncated, a blank field survives as a blank field, and no quoting rule is invented.
No clock, Node API, filesystem, network or randomness is used, and no argument is mutated.
No model reasoning, monologue or scratchpad text appears in any exported value or comment.
